Total number of questions155

ICAR researches in rice and cotton
pests
1965. SHRI ANANTRAY DEV-
SHANKER DAVE: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of researches made by
the Indian Council of Agricultural Research
(ICAR) to protect rice and cotton from
devastating pests;
(b) the details of other projects
undertaken by the ICAR under National
Agricultural Projects; and
(c) whether genetically engineered
cotton and rice would be made available to
farmers?
Banning Endo-sulfin, a poisonous
pesticide
1966. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether, within days of spraying
Endo-sulfin, a pesticide, in Kesargod in
Kerala, to protect the plantations form tea
mosquitoes, even the small birds and flies
were found dead and in Padri village, about
100 out of 2000 villagers were either dead/
congenially deformed;
(b) whether, at the time of spraying a
notice, warning villagers to cover all sources
of water, had been given, if so, what about
two rivers which are the main source of
drinking water; and
(c) if so, what are the reasons for not
banning the use of such poisonous pesticide
in India when its use is banned in most
developing countries?
Central team’s report on floods in
Andhra Pradesh
1967. SHRI SOLIPETA RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY: Will the Minister
of AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Team for
assessment of damages due to heavy rains
and floods in Andhra Pradesh, has
submitted its report to the Union
Government;
(b) if so, the details of the report; and
(c) by when the expected funds are to
be released to Andhra Pradesh?

WIN2\SESSION\3789rs 425
Review of Crop Insurance Policy
1968. SHRI SOLIPETA RAMA-
CHANDRA REDDY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to refer to
answer to Unstarred Question 610, given in
the Rajya Sabha on the 23rd November, 2001
and state:
(a) by when, the Crop Insurance Policy
is expected to be reviewed;
(b) whether Government are aware that
farmers are not getting any relief, if crops
failure is in lesser villages in a unit of large
area; and
(c) whether Government are considering
to take one village as a single unit, in place of
existing whole mandal or two mandals?
Mite disease of Coconut
1969. PROF. A. LAKSHMISAGAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
Government that several coconut trees have
been infested with Mite attack;
(b) if so, the number of coconut trees
attacked by the Mite all over the country;
State-wise, and the financial losses
therefrom; and
(c) what action Government have initiated
to control the Mite attacks?
Disaster Management
1970. SHRI SATISH PRADHAN:
DR. KARAN SINGH:
SHRI C. M. IBRAHIM:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee on Disaster
Management has submitted its report;
(b) if so, the main recommendations made
by the Committee for prevention,
preparedness and mitigation of disasters;
(c) whether one of its
recommendations is to set up a separate
full-fledged Ministry for Disaster
Management; and
(d) if so, the decisions taken by
Government thereon?
Development of agriculture in
wasteland areas
1971. SHRI W. ANGOU SINGH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the total amount of funds released
so far to State Governments and NGOs,
for development of agriculture in the
wasteland areas, State-wise;
(b) how the monitoring and
supervision of the works are done; and
(c) the progress of the works in each
State?
Sale of children in famine stricken
areas
1972. SHRI KRISHNA KUMAR
BIRLA: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that certain
drought and famine affected areas in the
country, particularly Orissa, have come
to such a pass that the parents have sold
their children due to starvation;
(b) if so, what are the details thereof;
(c) whether any inquiry has been made
by Government to assess the famine
conditions in these areas, resulting in such
a situation; and
(d) the remedial measures taken by
Government in the famine stricken areas
in the country, to meet the situation?
